name: tmodel
description: Transformer encoder-decoder trained from scratch on Helsinki-NLP/opus_books with a WordLevel tokenizer. This is the validated best checkpoint; the run overfits from epoch 18 onward.

evaluation.scored_on: held-out validation split, seeded split, first 200 sentences

overfitting.note: BLEU-4 peaked at epoch 17 and fell for the two remaining epochs while training loss kept dropping. The epoch-19 checkpoint was discarded. See results/wordlevel/RUN_REPORT.md.

usage.translate: python translate.py "But it was too late."
usage.translate_epoch17: python translate.py --checkpoint 17 "The cat sleeps on the table."
usage.note: preload is 'latest', so with a single checkpoint in model/ all scripts resolve to it automatically. The tools/ scripts import this project from the parent directory and can be run from any working directory. The Colab notebook overrides model_folder and tokenizer_file to point at Google Drive.

known_limitations: WordLevel tokenizer with no subwords: unseen words collapse to [UNK], and inflected forms share no representation.
No lowercasing, so 'zij' and 'Zij' are separate vocabulary entries.
~44% of the English and ~40% of the Dutch vocabulary entries are never used in the corpus.
No weight tying between the target embedding and the projection layer.
Constant learning rate, no schedule; the NoAM schedule exists but is opt-in.
No KV cache: decoding is O(n^2) in the generated length.
